exposure: restriction of additional feeding of fluids to medical indication
mode of birth (vaginal vs. Cesarean delivery)
outcome: compliance rates with WHO/UNICEF breastfeeding promotion recommendations
cohort: The study included 109 maternity hospitals in Germany.
finding: The implementation of WHO/UNICEF breastfeeding promotion sub-criteria in German hospitals varied widely, ranging from less than 25% to more than 90% for different aspects.
mod_finding: Immediate skin-to-skin contact and early breastfeeding initiation were implemented more frequently after vaginal births compared to Cesarean deliveries.
cross-section timing: Current hospital practices at the time of the web-based survey.
